wikitext: :[Jill addresses her mother, drawn with black hair in a ponytail. The mother was sitting at her computer at her desk, but has turned around on her office chair and is now facing the girl.] :Jill: Mommy, why is the sky blue? :Mother: Rayleigh scattering! Short wavelengths get scattered ''way'' more (proportional to 1/''λ''4). Blue light dominates because it's so short. :Jill: Oh. :Jill: So why ''isn't'' the sky violet? :Mother: Well, because, uh... ...hmm. :[Caption Below the panel:] :My hobby: Teaching tricky questions to the children of my scientist friends.
